message.reasoning_content: 1966 Revolver — not nearer 1970? 1966 is nearer 1970 (4 vs 4... 1970-1966=4, 1966-1962=4). "Late in career, nearer 1970" — 1966 is midpoint-ish; Revolver is late-ish. I'd say no? Hmm, tie. Released Aug 1966. Closer to 1962? equal. Late career: no, mid. Answer no, 0.6.
